title: Sections of pro-etale extension by zero vanish locally near the complement
statement: For any ring R, open immersion j: U -> X, module sheaf F on U_proet, weakly etale neighbourhood V over X, section s of j_!F over V, and point x of V outside the image of U, there is a pro-etale-site morphism f: Vprime -> V whose image contains x and on which s restricts to zero.

proof.text: Use local surjectivity of the sheafification unit for the presheaf left Kan extension along the open localization. Choose a covering family on which s lifts, and a member with a point y over x. The comma category computing the Kan extension at this member is empty: any object would factor its structure map through U, contradicting that y maps outside U. Its colimit is therefore zero, and the lifted section is zero. Naturality of the sheafification unit shows the restriction of s is zero. This is the existing complete proof of AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.exists_map_eq_zero_openImmersionLowerShriek in the source library.

lemma exists_map_eq_zero_openImmersionLowerShriek
    (F : Sheaf (ProEt.topology U) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)) {V : X.ProEt}
    (s : ToType (((j)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} R].obj F).obj.obj (op V))) (x : V.left)
    (hx : V.hom.base x ∉ Set.range j.base) :
    ∃ (V' : X.ProEt) (f : V' ⟶ V), x ∈ Set.range f.left.base ∧
      ((j)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} R].obj F).obj.map f.op s = 0
